notes: The careers page iframes the Kula board at careers.kula.ai/clevertap, which server-renders every open card (no pagination) and exposes department + location dropdowns with filterOptions {departmentsDepth:2, departmentsEnabled:true, locationEnabled:true}. There is no keyword box and no filter query string: dropdown selection filters the rendered cards client-side. The board's data endpoint https://api.kula.ai/v1/job-boards/job-posts accepts only ?page=N with the bearer token embedded in the entry page, so no native filter parameters are claimed.
